response.text: The memo says the invoice was meant to be charged to 5500 Travel. The correction reclassifies the 4018.13 debit from the invalid account 5950 to 5500, so it needs two lines: a credit of 4018.13 to 5950 to zero it out, and a debit of 4018.13 to 5500. The journal group stays balanced. Period 1 is closed, so both lines post to open period 11. No invoice status changes, since this is not a duplicate_invoice finding.
